title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
description:
Join Choco, where we build and own solutions that reshape a broken food system.
 The global food supply chain is inefficient by design. Waste is high, margins are thin, and most distributor order processes are done over the phone, tracked across broad spreadsheets, and based on intuition rather than strong data.
At Choco, we’re changing that. We build software used daily by food distributors and their customers to run their business. It automates orders, reduces errors, and helps operations run faster and more reliably. Because it’s embedded in daily operations, our SaaS platform has immediate, real-world impact, on efficiency, margins, and how businesses run day to day.
 As a Senior Data Platform Engineer, you'll build and evolve the data foundation that powers Choco's internal analytics, AI capabilities, and customer-facing data products.
As we scale to serve increasingly demanding enterprise customers, our data platform needs to meet higher standards for reliability, freshness, quality, and compliance. You'll own critical parts of our ingestion, transformation, and data platform ecosystem-helping us move toward enterprise-grade SLAs while making it easier for teams across Choco to build trustworthy data products.
This isn't a role focused purely on pipelines. You'll own problems end-to-end, from understanding why they matter to designing, shipping, operating, and driving adoption of scalable solutions.
 What you'll do
 Design and build a scalable data platform, from ingestion frameworks to the data products consumers rely on.
 Build and operate batch, streaming, and CDC pipelines across heterogeneous data sources.
 Deepen data observability and establish SLA/SLO frameworks around reliability, freshness, quality, and downstream impact.
 Implement PII masking, retention, and data contracts that make compliance and governance part of the platform by design.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
What do we do?
 Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

 Create and maintain complex, scalable data models in Snowflake using dbt.
 Expose datasets effectively in BI tooling to enable robust self-service analytics.
 Perform simple data ingestion tasks using no-code tools and ensure streamlined data flows.
 Add comprehensive metadata to datasets, including documentation, data quality checks, and sensitive data masking.
 Activate data by pushing it from Snowflake into other operational tools.
 Proactively identify and raise data quality issues to the respective process owners for resolution.
 Lead training sessions and initiatives to drive adoption and effective use of BI tools across the organization.
 Mentor junior analytics engineers, fostering knowledge-sharing and professional growth.
 We'd love to hear from you if you:
